Changed items democracy-autocracy-12, democracy-autocracy-15 are educated assumptions. Other 224 answers retain previous evidence and were checked for completeness and cross-axis consistency, not freshly independently researched. Prior review remains in revision 1. No score target was used. Existing images and credits retained. Normative response strength remains interpretive; 2026 Freedom House reports cover 2025 and some are abridged, so neither their scores nor absence of detailed text is imported as a quiz answer. neutralAnswers.rationale: Educated assumption: Article49 requires a competent-authority warrant but not explicitly an independent court, while political search safeguards are deficient. Mixed response weighs formal authorization and actual security discretion, without equating every competent authority with a court.

Educated assumption: Cultural/ethnic associations and general public-service equality coexist with common centralized provision. A mixed estimate weighs accommodation and unified standards; exact additional-spending duties remain unverified.

Educated assumption: Constitutional asylum protects specified political/national-liberation causes, while admission remains state-controlled. Mixed response weighs actual protection and selective scope, not an unrestricted automatic permanence rule.

Educated assumption: Political alliance and Spanish/Latin-American ties coexist with international education and solidarity. Mixed response distinguishes political preference from cultural-similarity admission ranking, which was not verified.

Educated assumption: Constitutional rejection of aggression coexists with armed solidarity for national liberation and a history of foreign campaigns. Mixed response distinguishes those commitments from current territorial deterrence; no present broad interests-only deployment doctrine was verified.
Educated assumption: Constitutional armed solidarity with liberation and resistance extends beyond only a direct attack on Cuba/an ally, while actual current doctrine stresses national defence.

Educated assumption: Formal peace principles coexist with repeated national combat readiness demonstrations. A mixed conflict estimate weighs both rather than declaring every risk-reduction concession paramount.

Educated assumption: International environmental cooperation and differentiated responsibilities coexist with national authority. A mixed estimate permits cooperation without inventing supranational environmental government.

Educated assumption: Solidarity and multilateral commitments coexist with national nonintervention and independent interest. A mixed estimate concerns collective enforcement at an immediate cost, which was not comprehensively verified.

Educated assumption: Owner-occupied private housing and state housing guarantees coexist. Mixed response concerns public rental ownership specifically; constitutional housing access does not quantify a substantial public rental stock.

Educated assumption: Historical low average tariffs coexist with national-production and authorization protection. Mixed response addresses protection-motivated tariffs; sanctions imposed by the United States are excluded as Cuban trade policy.

Educated assumption: July2026 liberalization and foreign-investment support coexist with approval controls and strategic protection. Mixed broad-barrier-removal estimate reflects actual competing policy, not every2023 restriction unchanged.

Educated assumption: Domestic essential-production goals coexist with urgent essential imports amid shortage. Mixed response distinguishes support to capacity from verified import bans for cheaper essentials.

Educated assumption: Domestic agricultural capacity promotion coexists with severe food-import dependence and authorized foreign agricultural cooperation. Mixed response weighs actual policies without assuming every agricultural import restricted.

Educated assumption: Enterprise competitiveness and new trade freedoms coexist with state development protection. Mixed response recognizes current reforms rather than forcing all firms into either unfettered competition or universal shielding.

Educated assumption: National taxes and import charges coexist with special foreign-investment/customs regimes. Mixed product-tax estimate avoids equating tariffs with all domestic consumption taxes; complete current equal-tax exceptions were not audited.
Educated assumption: September enterprise Article25 allows choosing products/services and private business permissions expand, while constitutional national planning and state-set objectives remain.
Educated assumption: Current law permits enterprise market-reference prices and private markets coexist with essential price controls; prices are not uniformly one mechanism.

Educated assumption: Autonomous product decisions and lawful business cessation coexist with national goals and state ownership. Mixed response weighs current market-oriented reform and continued planning; no universal consumer-only closure rule was verified.
Educated assumption: Expanded permitted private activities and enterprise autonomy coexist with authorization and conditional/restricted sectors, rather than uniform need-based approval.
Educated assumption: Article25 allows union-agreed enterprise wage organization while national minima and budgetary schedules remain; this is genuine mixed wage-setting institutional scope.

Educated assumption: Lawful private housing rentals and market activity coexist with state housing institutions and historically very low costs. Mixed response concerns actual rent-setting, not owner occupancy; a complete current rent-control consolidation was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Actual assistance increasingly provides survival protection under severe inflation, while statutory welfare/equality aims go beyond a minimal safety net. Mixed response separates actual cash adequacy from universal in-kind services.

Educated assumption: Greater enterprise/earnings autonomy coexists with progressive tax and equality purposes. Mixed response weighs actual incentive liberalization and redistributive obligations, not generalized socialist labeling.

Educated assumption: Employment duty and targeted assistance coexist with social protection and continuing insufficient-income need. Mixed response weighs work expectations and benefit protection; no universal irrevocable expiry while still poor was verified.

Educated assumption: Constitutional dignified material/social projects exceed basic survival, but actual cash adequacy is deeply eroded. Mixed response weighs goals and delivered purchasing capacity; public schooling/health alone do not answer income sufficiency.

Educated assumption: Religious holidays and revived public religious accommodation coexist with constitutional secular status. Mixed response distinguishes keeping cultural holidays from officially declaring a religion; exact holiday recognition motive was not audited.

Educated assumption: Long family consultation and managed institutional transition coexist with eventual substantial reform. Mixed response distinguishes state-controlled pace from an invariant rule to slow every popular change.

Educated assumption: Environmental assessment exists but often yields to economic priorities. Mixed response reflects actual safeguards and override practice rather than a verified universal poorly-understood-effects delay rule.

Educated assumption: Accelerated innovation and existing biosafety/medical oversight pull in different directions on irreversible harm. Mixed response weighs actual institutions; no blanket cross-technology strong-evidence rule was verified.
Educated assumption: Municipal autonomy is constitutionally recognized but constrained by national interests and obligatory superior orders; it is not sovereign regional authority.

Educated assumption: Territorial development contributions and local budgets coexist with national tax law and centrally defined policy. Mixed response distinguishes own fiscal resources from independently variable comprehensive tax rates, whose current scope was not fully audited.

Educated assumption: Local territorial/urban planning and resource administration coexist with national environmental institutions and superior authority. Mixed response addresses genuinely local effects without inventing regional wildlife sovereignty.
Educated assumption: Responsive care and individualized health/development coexist. An interaction estimate fits stress sensitivity specifically; no comparative biological predominance was adopted.
Educated assumption: Inclusive learning environments and individualized disability/development support both affect attention. Mixed interaction is likeliest, not an invented predominance finding.
Educated assumption: Individual developmental/health differences coexist with care and learning intervention. A mixed estimate fits temperament specifically; neither predominant cause was quantified.
